# Tramec, LLC

Tramec, LLC is a Manufacturing company. Tramec LLC manufactures and distributes heavy duty trucking and industrial products through its industry-leading brands and "American-Made" business model. Tramec, LLC employs 30 people (+15.4% YoY, +4 people) and has an annual revenue of $49.6M. Headquartered in Iola, Kansas, United States, with an office in Shawnee. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Australia, and Sri Lanka.

## About

Tramec is a family of companies providing a broad variety of components and assemblies for commercial vehicle, heavy equipment, air handling, fluid control, automotive, and construction markets. Our companies include Continental-Aero, CS Automation, Esdan Plastics, Fleet Engineers, Penz Products, Tramec Plastics & Composites, and Tramec Sloan.
